title: OT/ICS patch feasibility assessment for a CVE ID. Pass ?id=CVE-XXXX-XXXX. Return
description: OT/ICS patch feasibility assessment for a CVE ID. Pass ?id=CVE-XXXX-XXXX. Returns patch availability (from NVD references), vendor advisory URLs, OT-safe workarounds, patch complexity for the affected ICS layer, estimated downtime in minutes, whether safe to patch live, recommended maintenance window, deployment strategy, CISA KEV status, and a risk-vs-disruption score (1–10 with rationale). DeepSeek-enriched.
